login.heroTitle: Safer barangays, one patrol at a time.
login.heroSubtitle: GIS-based patrol management, secure QR checkpoints, incident mapping, and resident reporting — all in one place.
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue to your console

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Join your barangay's E-Tanod community
signup.approvalHint: Your account must be approved by a barangay admin before you can sign in.
signup.doneDesc: Your account is now pending approval by your barangay admin. You will be able to sign in once it is approved.

dashboard.heroAdminDesc: Monitor patrols, verify incidents, and keep your barangay safe in real time.
dashboard.heroFieldDesc: Your patrols, checkpoints, and incident reports — right at your fingertips.
dashboard.homeDesc: You are logged in as {{role}}. Explore your dashboard to manage patrols, checkpoints, incidents, and community reports.

patrol.title: Patrol
patrol.emptyDesc: You don't have any assigned patrols at the moment.
patrol.endHint: Add a summary of this patrol (optional).
patrol.endPlaceholder: e.g. Completed all checkpoints, no incidents encountered.

scan.title: Scan Checkpoint
scan.tanodDesc: Verify a checkpoint during your patrol
scan.needsActive: You need an active patrol to scan checkpoints. Start one from the Patrol page.
scan.onlyTanod: Only an active patrol tanod can verify a checkpoint.

VALID.title: Checkpoint verified
VALID.desc: Location matched within the geofence radius.

DUPLICATE.title: Already scanned
DUPLICATE.desc: This checkpoint was already verified in this session.

NOT_IN_PATROL.title: Not in your patrol
NOT_IN_PATROL.desc: This checkpoint is not part of your assigned route.

LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE.title: Location unavailable
LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE.desc: We could not determine your location accurately.

OUTSIDE_RADIUS.title: Outside geofence
OUTSIDE_RADIUS.desc: You are too far from this checkpoint to verify it.

INVALID.title: Invalid token
INVALID.desc: This QR token could not be matched to a checkpoint.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.emptyDesc: Incident reports and updates will appear here.
incidents.residentEmptyDesc: Residents can report incidents. The barangay will review and respond to your report.

users.title: Users
users.pendingHint: Approving activates the account so the member can sign in.

audit.title: Audit Logs
audit.emptyDesc: Security-sensitive actions will be logged here.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.desc: An unexpected error occurred while rendering this view.
error.info: Your data is safe. Try reloading the page.

landing.heroDesc: GIS-based patrol management, secure QR checkpoints, incident mapping, and resident reporting — all in one place.
landing.featuresDesc: Built for tanods and barangay officials, E-Tanod keeps patrols accountable and incidents visible in real time.

checkpoints.title: Secure QR checkpoints
checkpoints.desc: Geofence-verified patrol checkpoints that keep every shift accountable.

map.title: Live incident map
map.desc: GIS-based incident reporting with real-time status updates.

patrol.title: Patrol tracking
patrol.desc: Real-time patrol sessions with verifiable scan records.

reports.title: Resident reports
reports.desc: Community members can report incidents in seconds.

landing.installDesc: Add E-Tanod to your home screen for a fast, full-screen, offline-ready experience.
landing.installAndroid: Android: open the browser menu, then tap "Add to Home screen".
landing.installIos: iPhone or iPad: tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
landing.installDesktop: Desktop: click the install icon in the address bar.
landing.contactDesc: E-Tanod is developed as an academic capstone research system. For questions or feedback:
landing.footerTag: Barangay Security · Real-time patrol & incident management
